title: 1894 Shōnai earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1894 Shōnai earthquake", at revision 1366164698, opens: "The 1894 Shōnai earthquake is an earthquake occurred on October 22, 1894 at Sakata, Yamagata Prefecture in Japan. It was caused by the movement of the Shonai Plain Eastern Margin Fault Zone (庄内平野東縁断層帯)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11485805, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "earthquake in Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
